ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes. A central black vertical pillar bisects the fluke at the peduncle, branching into horizontal filigrees near the median notch. Small, discrete black circular focal spots are mapped to the mid-section of the right lobe. Dark peripheral bands follow the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serration along the trailing edge. Distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys are concentrated at the distal ends and the upper borders of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory with the outer tips curving significantly superior to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast textured clusters (barnacle growth) at both distal tips. Multiple dark circular ring-like pixel clusters (rosette scars) are mapped on the white background of the right lobe mid-field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple long, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe surface; several shorter diagonal streaks on the lower-left ventral field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the lateral tips; distinct parallel rake marks (linear scars) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-brown low-intensity gradient staining (diatom film) visible across the lower interior quadrants of both white lobe fields.
